description: First Casimir q-correction structure for conj:casimir-epsilon-vacuum: torus closures contribute Vol=0; the first hyperbolic mode is 4_1 (the substrate-defining knot); its q-weight is J_{4_1}(q)=1+(3/4)h²+O(h⁴), exact leading 3/4. Absolute 1/d-power awaits the interacting mode-sum.

minimal_closures_volume_table.verdict: torus closures (Hopf, trefoil, 5_1, all (2,n)) have Vol=0 → no q-deformation; the first hyperbolic mode is 4_1.

substrate_self_consistency.implication: The FIRST Casimir q-correction is governed by 4_1 — the SAME hyperbolic knot that defines the substrate q0. The first interacting Casimir correction and the substrate parameter share one hyperbolic invariant, Vol(4_1) = 2·Cl₂(π/3).

honest_scope.established: (a) first q-correction is hyperbolic/interacting only; (b) carried by 4_1, the substrate-defining knot; (c) q-weight J_{4_1}(q)=1+(3/4)h²+O(h⁴), exact leading 3/4.
honest_scope.NOT_established: the absolute 1/d power ('1/d⁶') and overall magnitude — these need the interacting-mode mode-sum (open Yekutieli-homotopy lift of N_⊙ on degree-≥2 closures). This probe gives the q-WEIGHT and structure, NOT a numerical Casimir coefficient.

caveats: Structural probe. Gives the q-weight (J_{4_1}) and the identification of the first hyperbolic mode (4_1 = substrate-defining knot); does NOT claim a numerical 1/d⁶ Casimir coefficient — that awaits the interacting-mode mode-sum (open).
